metric.strong: share of pixels whose largest RGB channel difference exceeds 64 after a 3x3 box blur of both images (ImageDiff)
metric.mean: mean largest RGB channel difference without blur, 0-255
metric.heightDifference: native minus Cordova height in device pixels (density 2)

rule: a comparison passes when the widths are equal, strong <= recorded + margin.strong, mean <= recorded + margin.mean and the height difference <= recorded heightDifference + margin.heightDifference
recordedOn: Robolectric 4.17, SDK 34, native graphics, macOS arm64; the references are the captures in privacy-reference/<lang>
why: Residual differences are glyph rasterization: the emulator's Android 16 fonts against Robolectric's SDK 34 fonts, larger for the Korean popup's ten lines and bold buttons than for the About popup. Geometry follows the WebView: the popup is AN-12's Ionic popup (250 dp, 49 dp head, the body on `line-height: normal` lines of 20 dp, buttons of 112.5 by 45 dp 5 dp apart at 0.87 opacity, a label too long for its button wrapping there as Chrome wraps the English 'Decline / withdraw'), its body broken where Chrome breaks it (chromeLines: the ten Korean and twelve English lines match the capture's line boxes in analytics-popup.json), and the menu is AN-07's. 2026-11-15 (#2990): menu cases re-measured after the privacy rows moved to the end of the side menu; native and Cordova show the same rows, the residuals are glyph rasterization. 2026-11-24 (analytics default-on, B34): failing cases re-measured after the native menu row became 이용 통계 · 꺼짐 / 켜짐 (Usage analytics · Off / On) and the popup title 이용 통계, native texts the Cordova captures (선택적 이용 통계 · 꺼짐 / 동의함) cannot show; the added residual is that row's and title's text.
